join hortbot 999 foobar 1


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :+whatprefix
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=admin :+whatprefix
send hortbot #foobar [HB] The prefix for this channel is: !

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set prefix +
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :+whatprefix
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=admin :+whatprefix
send hortbot #foobar [HB] The prefix for this channel is: +


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :+set prefix ?
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=admin :+whatprefix
send hortbot #foobar [HB] The prefix for this channel is: ?
